config.musicbot.title: Voice Chat Music Bot
config.musicbot.clothMissing: The config screen needs the mod Cloth Config. Install it, or edit config/musicbot.json and run /musicbot reload.
config.musicbot.owners.tooltip: Player names or UUIDs with full control: every command, also via chat, and managing members.
config.musicbot.members.tooltip: Player names or UUIDs that may use the normal music commands.
config.musicbot.membersCanDownload.toolt: Allow members (not only owners) to save songs into the library.
config.musicbot.allowLocalFiles.tooltip: Allow owners to play files from this PC by their absolute path.
config.musicbot.commandPrefix.tooltip: Prefix for commands in public chat, e.g. ! for !play. Private messages work without prefix.
config.musicbot.whisperCommand.tooltip: Command for private replies, without slash. Needs the placeholders {player} and {message}.
config.musicbot.replyDelayTicks.tooltip: Minimum delay between two bot messages, so the server does not kick the bot for spam. 20 ticks = 1 second.
config.musicbot.announceTracks.tooltip: Post a message when a new track starts.
config.musicbot.systemMessagePatterns.to: Only for servers whose chat plugins send private messages as system messages. Regular expressions with the groups (?<sender>...) and (?<message>...). See the README.
config.musicbot.chatMessagePatterns.tool: Like the private message patterns, but for public chat sent as system messages. Here the command prefix is required.
config.musicbot.searchPrefix.tooltip: yt-dlp search used for text without a link: ytsearch1: = YouTube, scsearch1: = SoundCloud.
config.musicbot.maxPlaylistItems.tooltip: Maximum number of tracks loaded from one playlist.
config.musicbot.maxQueueSize.tooltip: Maximum number of tracks in the queue.
config.musicbot.headBob.tooltip: Nod the bot's head to the beat while music is playing.
config.musicbot.headBobStrength.tooltip: How far the head nods down per beat, in degrees.
config.musicbot.headBobSway.tooltip: Also turn the head slightly left and right on alternating beats.
config.musicbot.maxDownloadMinutes.toolt: Longest track that may be saved into the library. 0 = unlimited.
config.musicbot.useLibraryCache.tooltip: When a link is requested that is already saved, play the local file instead of streaming it again.
config.musicbot.virtualMicrophone.toolti: Replace the hardware microphone with a virtual one, so no audio device is needed (Remote Desktop, headless PC).
config.musicbot.suppressMicrophone.toolt: Never transmit the bot's real microphone, only the music.
config.musicbot.autoJoinInvites.tooltip: Automatically join voice chat groups when an owner or member invites the bot.
config.musicbot.webPanel.tooltip: Control the bot from a browser. The panel has owner rights, so it is off by default.
config.musicbot.webPanelBind.tooltip: 0.0.0.0 = reachable in your local network, 127.0.0.1 = only this PC. Never expose the panel to the internet.
config.musicbot.webPanelPort.tooltip: Port the web panel listens on.
config.musicbot.webPanelPassword.tooltip: Password for the web panel. Leave empty to generate a new random one.
config.musicbot.autoDownloadDependencies: Download yt-dlp, ffmpeg and Deno automatically if they are missing.
config.musicbot.autoUpdateYtDlp.tooltip: Update the yt-dlp downloaded by the mod on every start. YouTube changes often.
config.musicbot.useDeno.tooltip: Use Deno as JavaScript runtime for yt-dlp. Needed for full YouTube support.
config.musicbot.ytDlpPath.tooltip: Keep yt-dlp for automatic detection and download, or set a full path to your own executable.
config.musicbot.ffmpegPath.tooltip: Keep ffmpeg for automatic detection and download, or set a full path to your own executable.
config.musicbot.denoPath.tooltip: Keep deno for automatic detection and download, or set a full path to your own executable.
config.musicbot.ytDlpExtraArgs.tooltip: Added to every yt-dlp call, one argument per entry, e.g. --cookies-from-browser and firefox.
config.musicbot.error.noSpaces: Must not be empty or contain spaces
config.musicbot.error.searchPrefix: Must end with a colon, e.g. ytsearch1:
config.musicbot.error.player: Not a valid player name or UUID
